title: Ilocos Sur police report no untoward incidents during Undas 2026

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The Ilocos Sur Police Provincial Office (ISPPO) reported no untoward incidents during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, as police personnel maintained security and assisted cemetery-goers across the province. In a statement on Tuesday, the ISPPO said its personnel conducted patrols and security checks, managed crowds, facilitated pedestrian and vehicular traffic, and provided assistance to the public as part of its Undas 2026 security operations.
